name: com.hhmedic.android.sdk.video.chat.RtcVideoAct
description: HH Medics’ doctor and PingAn SDKs use this screen for live clinician-patient video consultations. It sets up the call’s real-time audio and video connection and keeps consultation messages in sync.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent HH Medics video consultations from opening or connecting.
